purpose: Claim-noun complements and reported-false paraphrases — the exact class behind both Meridian trap leaks. The only positive graph edge permitted from this document is C01 (C02 optionally corroborates it).

items.evidence: The Harrier Gateway uses the Onyx Ledger.
The audit confirmed that the Harrier Gateway uses the Onyx Ledger in every deployment region.

must_not.notes: attributed confirmation; graded leniently, but it must not create a second distinct edge

items.evidence: An early memo claimed that the Harrier Gateway uses the Cobalt Vault.

must_not.notes: verb-frame attribution — the case the current system already handles; regression guard

items.evidence: The review board rejected the statement that the Harrier Gateway uses the Cobalt Vault.

must_not.notes: claim-NOUN complement under rejecting matrix verb — Meridian leak #1 class

items.evidence: The incorrect claim that Northgale Group owns the Onyx Ledger passed an early review before it was removed.

items.evidence: It was incorrectly reported that Dr. Wen Castillo owns the Harrier Gateway.

Northgale Group retracted its statement that the Onyx Ledger depends on the Cobalt Vault.

The Harrier Gateway does not use the Cobalt Vault.

items.evidence: The Harrier Gateway may adopt the Cobalt Vault next year.

must_not.notes: conditional scope; 'alert storm' should also not be minted as a graph node

invariants: positive graph from this document contains exactly one edge: Harrier Gateway -uses-> Onyx Ledger
every qualified item is preserved as a canonical qualified/attributed record (dropping them entirely is also a failure — they are evidence)
